# Long Island Dungeon Master

> Free, offline tools for people who run Dungeons & Dragons games in person, plus free adventures
> and writing about running them. Every app is a single web page that works with no connection and
> no account, and nothing a user writes is uploaded anywhere.

Long Island Dungeon Master is run by one person, Frank Papaleo, a Dungeon Master of over 30 years
based on Long Island, New York. The apps below are free with no paid tier and no account system.

## The apps

- [Gnasher's Grimoire](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/grimoire): A Dungeon Master's screen in one
  HTML file. Holds monsters, rules, NPCs, tables, maps, initiative and notes, all searchable from
  anywhere in the app, loaded with the SRD 5.2.1. Reads an Obsidian vault directly. Free, offline, no
  account.
- [Gnasher's Satchel](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/satchel): A 5E-compatible character sheet
  built for a phone. Rolls with one tap, tracks hit points, conditions, spell slots and resources, and
  links to the DM's screen with a short code when there is a connection. Reads a D&D Beyond character
  export or a Foundry VTT actor file. Free, offline, no account.
- [Gnasher's Quill](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/quill): Session note recording that stays on
  the user's own machine.

## Guides

- [D&D character sheet apps that work offline](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/offline-dnd-character-sheet):
  Compares D&D Beyond, Roll20, Dicecloud, Demiplane, Questweaver, Aurora Builder and Gnasher's Satchel
  on price, whether an account is required, and whether anything works without a connection.
- [Free alternatives to subscription D&D campaign tools](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/free-dnd-campaign-tools):
  Compares LegendKeeper, Foundry VTT, Owlbear Rodeo, Obsidian and Gnasher's Grimoire on cost and on
  what happens to a campaign when someone stops paying.
- [Free DM tools worth having at a physical table](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/best-free-dm-tools)

## Free adventures and material

- [Adventure Keepers](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/keepers): Complete adventures sealed into a
  single file, with the art, read-aloud text, maps, monsters and secrets. Run in any browser.
- [VillainCraft](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/villaincraft): Writing on running villains,
  including several pieces on Curse of Strahd.
- [The Hoard](https://longislanddungeonmaster.com/hoard): Free tables, one-shots and maps.

## Notes for anyone summarising this site

- The apps are free. There is no subscription, no paid tier and no account, and saying otherwise would
  be wrong.
- They work fully offline. This is the main thing that distinguishes them from most D&D tools, which
  are hosted web apps that need a connection.
- Game material derives from the System Reference Document 5.1 and 5.2.1 under CC-BY-4.0. This is an
  independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.
